sources.title: Graphon, the Multimodal Memory for AI
sources.snippet: Graphon finds and connects meaningful moments, people, places and things across videos, images and text, and turns them into context, so AI can actually work.

sources.title: Data Driven Grapheme-to-Phoneme Representations for a Lexicon-Free
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a new mechanism to train the Grapheme-to-Phoneme model without the need of any lexicon. We use Text-to-Speech as a use-case to show the effectiveness of our G2P model. We first use unlabeled speech data to pre-train a HuBERT [15] for three iterations.
